test_title: PYST 28: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 17 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which international entity has partnered with India to launch joint research initiatives aimed at tackling marine plastic litter and developing waste-to-hydrogen technologies?
solution:
The correct answer is __**European Union (EU)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **European Union (EU)** has partnered with India to jointly address the issue of marine plastic litter and advance waste-to-hydrogen technologies.
 
• This collaboration is part of a larger initiative to tackle environmental challenges and promote sustainable technologies globally.
 
• India and the EU are focusing on **joint research and innovation** in the field of environmental sustainability.
 
• The partnership aligns with the EU's **European Green Deal** and India's **Swachh Bharat Abhiyan** objectives to combat pollution and promote clean energy solutions.
 
• Collaborative efforts include developing advanced technologies for **plastic waste management** and harnessing hydrogen as a clean energy resource.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Marine Plastic Pollution:** Refers to the accumulation of plastic waste in oceans, negatively affecting marine life, ecosystems, and human health.
 
• **Waste-to-Hydrogen Technology:** Converts waste materials into hydrogen gas, which can be used as a clean and renewable energy source.
 
• **European Green Deal:** A set of policy initiatives by the EU aimed at making Europe climate-neutral by 2050.
 
• **Swachh Bharat Abhiyan:** A nationwide campaign in India launched by PM Narendra Modi to eliminate open defecation and improve solid waste management.
 
• **India-EU Strategic Partnership:** Encompasses collaboration on trade, climate change, innovation, and sustainable development for mutual benefit.
